tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair refuses candidate graph growth while persisting the rejected receipt
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx8g' ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair refuses candidate graph growth while persisting the rejected receipt'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: With maximumGraphBytes=8,920 and headroom in the other budget fields, the test establishes a fresh graph under the cap, dispatches once to a scripted ACP peer that acknowledges an authorized source modification, and then observes the graph-byte admission refusal before candidate validation. It verifies the exact graph-byte budget exception, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED terminal run, receipt and rejected assessment binding, observed path/preimage/postimage/size commitments, unchanged accepted source and head, no pending attempt or candidate blob residue, graph size within the cap after rejection, and verified final-snapshot/process/sandbox cleanup.
qualificationLimits: uses an injected validation strategy and does not qualify production validation under #236
does not establish live-provider behavior or hosted exact-head CI
does not establish publication crash recovery under #732 or durable provenance under #733
other graph limits and the complete #734/#63 acceptance matrix remain open
